evals.name: plan-pause-relay-action-gate
evals.prompt: `phase.py` returned `plan-pause`. Plan file exists with task headings. `log.md` has a `plan` line, `tasks_total == 0`.; user said "go"; agent wants to derive tasks or auto-execute without confirmation.
evals.expected_output: relays `unit.plan-pause` action gate; invokes flavor hook `hook-ws-resume-plan-pause`; does not derive tasks or start execution until confirmed.

evals.name: plan-pause-flavor-pick-2-subagent
evals.prompt: `unit.plan-pause` action gate relayed; flavor picker shown; user picks `2`.; agent tries to execute inline or start tasks without running `confirm_plan.py`.
evals.expected_output: runs `confirm_plan.py --context spec-driven-development=subagent`; verifies `confirmed` and `plan=done` receipt; executes via subagent workflow per flavor docs.

evals.name: plan-pause-flavor-pick-3-inline
evals.prompt: `unit.plan-pause` action gate relayed; flavor picker shown; user picks `3`.; agent runs subagents or forgets context line.
evals.expected_output: runs `confirm_plan.py --context spec-driven-development=inline`; verifies `confirmed` and `plan=done` receipt; executes inline workflow per flavor docs.

evals.name: plan-pause-colloquial-command-refused
evals.prompt: `phase.py` returned `plan-pause`. User says `/go inline` or colloquial "go" before picking from the flavor picker.; agent treats colloquial proceed as an execute choice without showing the numbered picker.
evals.expected_output: re-shows the numbered flavor picker; does not run `confirm_plan.py` or start execution until an explicit choice is made.

evals.name: plan-pause-headless-auto-confirm
evals.prompt: `phase.py --headless` returned `plan-pause`.; agent prompts the user or shows an interactive picker.
evals.expected_output: runs `confirm_plan.py --reason headless --context spec-driven-development=subagent`; no interactive hook fired.

evals.name: spike-plan-pause-confirm
evals.prompt: `phase.py` returned `plan-pause` for a spike; user confirms `2. Execute spike tasks`.; agent runs `confirm_plan.py` without `--kind spike`, or omits amend-design task.
evals.expected_output: runs `confirm_plan.py <slug> --kind spike`; progress gains tasks with final `Amend design spec` task and `plan=done` receipt; no context line appended.

evals.name: legacy-execute-mode-with-tasks-stays-loop
evals.prompt: unit log has legacy `execute-mode=subagent-driven` line, `progress.md` has `tasks_total > 0` (e.g. 1/3 done).; agent thinks unit is stalled at plan-pause because it lacks `plan=done`.
evals.expected_output: `phase.py` returns `loop`; agent continues normal loop execution without re-prompting plan-pause.

evals.name: tasks-total-stale-digest-stays-loop
evals.prompt: `progress.md` has partial tasks (e.g. 2/4 done); plan file on disk was modified or digest in log does not match.; agent tries to re-enter plan-pause or wipe tasks.
evals.expected_output: `phase.py` stays at `loop`; tasks in `progress.md` govern execution; does not re-enter plan-pause.
